info.title: FAMS — Face Attendance Management System
info.description:
He thong diem danh sinh vien bang nhan dien khuon mat - Truong Dai hoc Kien truc Da Nang.

* Xac thuc: `POST /api/v1/auth/login` (form `username`, `password`) lay access token, gui kem
  header `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Nut **Authorize** o tren dung luong nay.
* Loi: `{"detail": "...", "code": "..."}`; moi response co header `X-Request-ID`.
* Danh sach co phan trang: tham so `limit`, `offset`; tong so ban ghi o header `X-Total-Count`.

post.description: Form `username` (email), `password`. Tra access token + refresh token + vai tro.
Doi refresh token lay cap token moi (token cu bi thu hoi - xoay vong).
Gui ma OTP qua email; luon tra thong bao chung (khong lo email ton tai hay khong).
Dat lai mat khau bang OTP; moi token cu mat hieu luc.
Doi mat khau (phai dung mat khau hien tai); cap token moi cho phien hien tai.
